scope: Approximate >=< comparison on explicit POSITION/XYZWPR with host-supplied tolerance context

reference_basis.documented: Approximate POSITION equality returns BOOLEAN and uses location/orientation tolerance and configuration-check system variables; extended axes are excluded
reference_basis.uncertainty: Native numeric defaults, distance/angle metrics, CONFIG rules and mixed-type behavior remain unverified

implementation_choices.context: Explicit Program(pose_tolerance=(location_mm, orientation_deg, check_config)); finite nonnegative location, orientation 0..180 and exact bool; defensive immutable per-instance tuple and read-only property; no defaults; missing context fails only when comparison executes
implementation_choices.metrics: Inclusive math.dist location and shortest rotation angle; D=transpose(Ra)*Rb, degrees(atan2(half skew norm, clamp((trace(D)-1)/2,-1,1))); rounded Python floats without relative tolerance
implementation_choices.configuration: If requested, compare every CONFIG field; otherwise ignore differences after full validation
implementation_choices.validation: Complete exact initialized finite POSITION/XYZWPR including CONFIG; frame_policy proper POSITION matrices; reject non-finite derived distance; no matrix repair or kinematics
implementation_choices.effects: Evaluate once left-to-right and snapshot each operand before later effects; validate both operands before context/metrics; prior effects remain, destination unchanged and target expressions skipped on failure; ordinary Boolean/FOR/frame cleanup
implementation_choices.cli: Generated scripts containing the operator require --location-tolerance-mm, --orientation-tolerance-deg and exactly one of --check-config/--ignore-config; combine with READ/joint context; invalid bounds are usage errors
implementation_choices.reports: Source-located position_comparisons with actual operand types and capture flags; position_comparison_policy records context, metrics, CONFIG and limits; runtime tolerance is not translation-context hash input

retained_boundaries: No XYZWPREXT/JOINTPOS/VECTOR/scalar operands, exact/ordered pose comparisons, source system-variable access or implicit context
No external-axis comparison, frame discovery, native metric/configuration equivalence, kinematics or controller acceptance
Strict remains future work; authored fixtures and independent quaternion checks establish offline behavior only
